summary: Build and test XLSForms, practise offline ODK Collect workflows, and review ODK Central submissions. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Mobile phone-based data collection with ODK supports structured field surveys when connectivity is limited. For field researchers, monitoring and evaluation officers, and data coordinators, the training covers building and validating XLSForms, preparing ODK Collect for offline collection, tracking submissions in ODK Central, and exporting records for review.
audienceIntro: This training suits professionals who design, deploy, supervise, or process mobile surveys and structured field records using ODK. It is appropriate for foundation-level learners who need practical skills for a field data-collection workflow.
prerequisites: Basic smartphone navigation and familiarity with spreadsheet rows and columns are expected. No programming or coding is required; exercises use XLSForm spreadsheets and an Android device running ODK Collect.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
